findings.title: Real offline freezes every screen: a write made offline is applied but not shown until reconnect
findings.detail:
Re-check (run 2): FLOW-34 passes. context.setOffline(true), answer ROTI BAKAR 88: row leaves, badge 12 -> 11, Payments shows RM7.77 on top "Not synced yet", Home "2 not synced yet"; after reconnect unsynced 0, one row each, figure 1,923.50 unchanged. Also on the preview build with its service worker (FLOW-34b).

Run 1: TanStack Query's default networkMode ('online') pauses refetches once `navigator.onLine` is false. The fake applies the write, the toast says it worked, but Home's chip, Review's rows and Payments' marks stay stale. A person can answer the same row again. The dev panel's offline state never cuts the connection, so the repo's offline checks miss this. Every later slice plugs into this data layer.

back online: row on screen = 0
findings.spec: AC-12, AC-70, spec §5, patterns §7 Offline, flows.md offline

findings.title: A double tap on a Review answer applies it twice; Undo then does nothing useful
findings.detail:
Re-check (run 2): the ReviewRow guard resets as soon as the write resolves, while the row is still on screen, so a second tap inside that window answers again. 15 attempts on ROTI BAKAR 88 / Meals: 2 taps at 0 ms 3 clean, at 100 ms 3 clean, at 10 ms 1 clean and 2 doubled, at 40 ms 2 clean and 1 doubled; 3 taps at 10 ms 2 clean and 1 doubled. A doubled answer has 2 change lines and one Undo leaves the rule in place (rules 1, review 11). Only the transfer-missing case is now a no-op, in the fake.

Run 1: `txn.kind` (transfer with another account) creates the filled-in side with a fresh uuid on every call, and ReviewRow has no in-flight guard, so two taps make two inferred transactions and move the account balance twice. After a double-tapped share tick the single Undo toast restores only the second command's snapshot, so the row stays gone. A retried outbox sync would duplicate the same way.
findings.repro: Review > transfer-missing row > double-tap `Public Bank` (qa/e2e/b03-review.spec.ts, 'AC-18s double-tapping an answer')
findings.evidence:
double-tap on Public Bank: {"before":{"n":1199,"inferred":12},"after":{"n":1201,"inferred":14}}
after one Undo following a double tap, the row is back: false
findings.spec: AC-18s, AC-63, spec §6.5, CLAUDE.md "Every input has a dedupe key"

findings.title: The same receipt file twice is not "Already added": it becomes a second waiting receipt
findings.detail:
Re-check (run 2): FLOW-36 and FLOW-14: same bytes under another name -> "Already added", receipts unchanged; one byte different -> new receipt; same file after Undo -> accepted again. New related gaps: an empty or text file is not refused (finding 25), and over plain http Scan fails (finding 19).

Run 1: `upload(file, forTxnId)` makes a random draft id each time and never hashes the file, so the content-hash dedupe of §6.5 cannot be expressed through the backend interface. The first copy attaches; the second finds no free payment and waits in Review as if its payment hadn't arrived.

findings.spec: AC-31, spec §6.5, flows.md scan-after "The same file twice: Already added", CLAUDE.md dedupe

findings.title: A payment added just now is not at the top of Payments: ordering compares mixed-format timestamp strings
findings.detail:
Re-check (run 2): FLOW-37, RM1,234.56 saved now is the first row of Payments; the F4 unit test goes red when newestFirst is made a string sort (probe P4).

Run 1: Rows are sorted with `b.at.localeCompare(a.at)` on ISO strings. The scenario writes `+08:00` offsets; new payments use `…Z`. Compared as text, 12:40Z sorts below 19:58+08:00, so a payment saved at 20:40 KL lands 4th. The same string sort feeds Review's order and the 'last account used' default. Day totals still add correctly, so the screen disagrees with itself.

findings.title: A screen opens scrolled to the previous screen's offset
findings.detail: Every screen's `main` is the same element, so React keeps its scrollTop when the screen changes (`Screen` in `frame/screen.tsx`; the router's `scrollRestoration: true` handles `window`, not `main`). A short screen (More) clamps it back to 0, so it hides; a tall screen does not. Scroll Review down, tap Insights (opened before) and Insights opens halfway down; open Payments a second time and the search, the filters and the newest day are above the fold (the list starts at "Thu, 15 Oct"). It also explains why a Payments spec in the first sweep read "Nando's RM63.90" as the top row. Both screens opened first read 0, which is why run 1 missed it.

findings.title: Over plain http (a LAN preview) Scan fails with a raw JavaScript error
findings.detail: The fix for the same-file rule hashes the upload with `crypto.subtle.digest`, which does not exist outside a secure context (https or localhost). Picking a file on `http://<lan ip>:<port>` toasts the engine's own message. Production and the shell load https, so it bites only a phone pointed at a dev or preview server by IP; the hash will be the server's job in B05, but the screen should not show `digest`.
findings.repro: vite preview --host 0.0.0.0, open http://<ip>:5183/scan on a phone or in Chromium, choose any file.
findings.evidence:
isSecureContext false | crypto.subtle undefined
after picking a file over http: ... | toasts: [ "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'digest')" ]
